weather_correction.description: VV014 is now 1,400 feet; padded cloud codes are normalized. Raw METARs, all originals, previous datasets and candidate artifacts are retained. Frozen original models have unchanged held-out decisions on corrected inputs; newly trained candidates show mixed changes, not universal improvement.

corrected_models.forecast_result: HRRR partial-input diagnostic: 108 separate held-out nights at 1/3 hours, 107 at 6 hours. Recall 0% at all three warnings; Brier 0.2341 / 0.2335 / 0.2292 versus paired observed-input 0.1339 / 0.1339 / 0.1348. Every frost-reason case missed. This is NOT validated forecast skill.

Same HRRR partial-input nights: 1/3/6-hour recall 92.59 / 92.59 / 92.31%, but false-positive rates 51.85 / 51.85 / 50.62%. Brier 0.2810 / 0.2768 / 0.2608 versus paired observed-input 0.1564 / 0.1564 / 0.1571. Excessive false alarms and incomplete input compatibility prevent an operational claim.

forecast_coverage: LOCAL HRRR point data: 108 distinct held-out 2025-26 nights, September 3 through June 24; 108 cases per model at 1/3-hour warnings and 107 at 6 hours. One 6-hour cycle was unavailable; no substitute used. 4,368 source-body hashes verified. Original NOAA file write timestamps precede each accepted prediction cutoff; exact issue/receipt times remain unknown. Seasonal probes cannot establish timely availability for sampled 2015-20 archive objects. MOS still lacks dissemination proof; TAF lacks thermodynamic inputs.
shadow_state: Two LOCAL METAR + newly issued TAF + NWS-grid snapshots captured at 22:33 and 23:01 UTC on October 27. Single-command capture, checkpointing, failed-run recovery and offline-gap journal implemented. Hourly workstation scheduling option documented, NOT installed. No subsequent explicit outcome pairs verified.

models.forecast_result: Partial TAF stress test on 7 held-out sampled applications (2 frost-reason, 5 other): 1/3/6-hour recall 0/0/0%; Brier 0.2391/0.2390/0.2360. Not a complete-input forecast validation and far too small for a skill claim.

Partial TAF stress test on the same 7 held-out applications: 1/3/6-hour recall 50/50/50%; Brier 0.1312/0.1536/0.1120. Shared event-time above-freezing subset: 10/26 frost-reason cases detected (38.46%), versus forest 4/26. No operational forecast claim.

conclusion: Weather normalization is corrected and versioned. Useful operational advance-warning skill is NOT established: forecast-input compatibility, missingness and calibration remain substantial deficiencies despite the larger 108-night source sample. Three/six-hour scores are transfer diagnostics, not validated horizons. Original artifacts and research history are preserved; no candidate was submitted, approved or activated. Credible untreated aircraft and exposure observations remain necessary for physical frost prediction.
